news.headline: Seahawks' Quenton Nelson, Sam Darnold among starters ruled out
news.summary: New Seahawks trade acquisition Quenton Nelson will have a "minor procedure" and is one of six starters, including QB Sam Darnold, who won't play vs. the Cardinals.

news.headline: Giants' Cam Skattebo doubtful vs. Eagles; Malik Nabers 'full go'
news.summary: Giants running back Cam Skattebo is unlikely to play against the Eagles on Sunday, but receiver Malik Nabers is expected to be a "full go" without limitations.
